node_schema.rule: Every Phase 4 node has origin = source. Derived nodes MUST NOT be produced.

global_rules.retention_guarantee: Information not represented as a node is never dropped. It is retained in: (a) another node's payload, (b) provenance/evidence, (c) lookup/index data, or (d) the raw snapshot (raw_records.db). Lookup/evidence data required for deterministic resolution remains available.
global_rules.schema_is_north_star: node_id | type | origin | payload (not extended or replaced)
global_rules.origin_definition: origin = source refers to the node's IDENTITY / source record: the node is extracted from a source entity present in the game data. A payload MAY contain computed enrichment fields (e.g. Stat.observed_in, UniqueItem.resolved_targets, ModifierGroup member aggregates); those fields are provenance-tagged as enrichment and never change origin. Producing such enrichment is NOT producing a derived NODE.
global_rules.deduplication_general: node_id must be unique; where the source yields identical ids, see the per-type dedup rule.

Stat.source: repoe/stats.json (record_key = stat id); observed union additionally scanned from: mods.json stats[].id, passive_skill_trees/* passives.stats keys, gems.json constant_stats / per_level_stats ids, gems.json stat_conversions VALUES.
Stat.record_identification: One Stat node per stat id. Canonical set = stats.json record_keys. Observed-only set = ids found at the stat positions above that are NOT in stats.json (verified: currently 0; the rule is deterministic and may be non-empty after re-download).
Stat.inclusion: All canonical ids; all observed-only ids. legacy/dummy/observed-only ids are included and FLAGGED, never dropped.
Stat.exclusion: NOT stat ids: gems.json stat_text multi-line keys (display concatenations; 15,914 multi-line occurrences, 0 in stats.json) and gems.json stat_conversions KEYS (gem-local alias names). Both stay in the Gem payload.
Stat.provenance: raw_records('repoe/stats.json', <stat_id>, repoe@<commit>) for canonical; raw_records(<source_file>, <record_key>, <version>) for observed-only.
Stat.extraction_rule: Deterministic: for each stats.json record_key create a node; then scan the four stat positions, add any id not already present as observed_only.
Stat.dedup: stat_id string is unique (no dedup needed).

Modifier.record_identification: One Modifier node per mods.json record_key.
Modifier.inclusion: ALL records (every generation_type and domain). Modifier is an exact source entity / mechanic carrier; storage is exhaustive, exposure/filtering is query-time.
Modifier.extraction_rule: Deterministic: 1 node per record; payload copied from the parsed record verbatim.

ModifierGroup.source: distinct values of the source field repoe/mods.json groups[] (7,325) and pob/ModItemExclusive.json group (4,180) — TWO separate vocabularies, kept in separate namespaces.
ModifierGroup.record_identification: One node per distinct group string within its source vocabulary. The group string IS the source-origin entity: it is a literal value of the source field, exactly as a stat id is a literal value of stats.json.
ModifierGroup.inclusion: All distinct groups from both vocabularies. This is a source-origin vocabulary node (its semantic reading is 4C-pending); it is NOT a replacement for Modifier.
ModifierGroup.exclusion: Group occurrences are not separate nodes (membership lives on Modifier nodes).

payload.enrichment_note: the following fields are COMPUTED from member Modifier payloads; they are enrichment, not source fields, and do not alter origin
payload.domains: sorted unique domains observed for members, lexicographic ascending
payload.generation_types: sorted unique generation types observed for members, lexicographic ascending
payload.member_count: int - count of member Modifier nodes
payload.representative_text: text of the representative member (see enrichment_rules); null if that text is null

ModifierGroup.provenance: The group string is observed directly in raw_records('repoe/mods.json', <member_mod>, ...).groups[] and raw_records('pob/ModItemExclusive.json', <member_mod>, ...).group (source occurrences). Enrichment provenance = the member Modifier nodes (each with its own provenance). origin = source.
ModifierGroup.extraction_rule: Deterministic: union distinct group strings per vocabulary; compute enrichment (domains, generation_types, member_count, representative_text) from Modifier payloads exactly per enrichment_rules (tier = trailing record_key integer; Elevated precedence; tie-break lexicographically smallest record_key; sorted arrays).
ModifierGroup.dedup: dedup within vocabulary by group string; RePoE and PoB groups are NEVER merged.

enrichment_rules.tier_definition: tier of a member Modifier = the trailing integer of its record_key (0 if none). In RePoE numbering the LARGEST trailing integer is the STRONGEST roll (e.g. IncreasedLife12 = +(175-189) > IncreasedLife1 = +(10-24)).
enrichment_rules.elevated_precedence: members whose name contains 'Elevated' (elevated influence mods; 247 present, signalled in the name field) form a distinct stronger class and take precedence over non-elevated members for representative selection.
enrichment_rules.representative_member_selection: 1) if any Elevated member exists, restrict to Elevated members; else all members. 2) within that set, choose the member with the LARGEST trailing-integer tier. 3) tie-break: lexicographically smallest record_key.
enrichment_rules.representative_text_rule: representative_text = the representative member's text field (null if that text is null).
enrichment_rules.array_ordering: domains and generation_types are deduplicated and sorted lexicographically ascending (deterministic).
enrichment_rules.member_count_rule: member_count = number of member Modifier nodes in the group.

UniqueItem.source: repoe/uniques.json (one record per numeric record_key; 1,556). No stats in this file; stats are reached via the unique_item_resolver (below).
UniqueItem.record_identification: One node per uniques.json record_key. Alternate-art, renamed and base versions are SEPARATE records/nodes (linked via payload).
UniqueItem.inclusion: ALL 1,556 records. Unresolved/unmatched uniques are never discarded.

resolved_targets.validated: bool (always false at extraction; confirmation is a later phase)

UniqueItem.provenance: raw_records('repoe/uniques.json', <record_key>, repoe@<commit>); each resolved target carries its own provenance.
UniqueItem.extraction_rule: Deterministic node creation from uniques.json; resolved_targets + resolution_status/evidence populated by the resolver function (below). If the resolver cannot run for a record, resolution_status defaults to 'unresolved_by_current_resolver' (empty resolved_targets is NOT absence).
UniqueItem.unresolved_handling: Empty resolved_targets is not proof of absence. Status distinguishes unresolved-by-resolver / no-source-text / genuinely-absent-confirmed (evidence-backed only).

Passive.source: repoe/passive_skill_trees/*.json (7 trees; a tree is a single-file record; entity unit = one entry of its passives map, keyed by hash string).
Passive.record_identification: One node per distinct passive id field. The same passive id appears in multiple trees.
Passive.inclusion: ALL passive entries (regular, notable, keystone, jewel-socket, ascendancy-start, multiple-choice). No size-based exclusion; exposure is query-time.
Passive.exclusion: Tree scaffolding (art/groups/roots/title) is not a node (tree provenance).

payload.id: string — passive id (identity); identical across all variants by construction
payload.name: string — identical across variants for a given id
payload.conflict: bool — false when every tree's record for this id is byte-identical (after parse); true otherwise
payload.shared: object — when conflict=false: the full common record fields {name, kind_flags, flavour_text, icon, reminder_text, skill_points, stats, hash:int}. When conflict=true: ONLY the fields identical across ALL variants (intersection; at minimum {name}); differing fields are NOT present here
payload.variants: array|null — null when conflict=false. When conflict=true: one entry per source tree containing the id, FULL lossless per-tree records: [{"tree": "repoe/passive_skill_trees/<file>.json", "hash": int, "record": {id, name, kind_flags, flavour_text, icon, reminder_text, skill_points, stats}}]
payload.trees: [{"file": "tree file", "hash": "int"}] — union of source trees where the id occurs (both branches)

Passive.extraction_rule: Deterministic: iterate all trees' passives, group by id. If all per-tree records for the id are identical: merge (conflict=false, shared = the record, trees[] union). Otherwise: conflict=true, shared = intersection of fields equal across ALL variants, variants = one full per-tree record per source tree (no canonical pick, no reconciliation).
Passive.dedup: merge by id only when payloads are identical; otherwise conflict flag + variants retained.

Gem.record_identification: One node per gems.json record_key (variant records like AbsolutionAltX are separate).
Gem.exclusion: per_level stat lines are NOT nodes (retained in payload).
Gem.extraction_rule: Deterministic: 1 node per record; payload copied verbatim (stat_text keys with literal \n preserved; null slots preserved).

Tag.source: tag vocabulary observed in mods.json (spawn_weights[].tag 499, implicit_tags[] 58, adds_tags[] 52); tags.json/tag_details.json are OPTIONAL candidate sources for inheritance enrichment only
Tag.record_identification: One node per distinct tag string.
Tag.exclusion: Tag occurrences/weights are not nodes (Modifier payload).

payload.inherits_from: string|null - null when the candidate inheritance source (tags.json / tag_details.json) is unavailable; inheritance enrichment is optional and NEVER prevents Tag extraction

Tag.extraction_rule: Deterministic: union of distinct tag strings across the three mods.json fields (spawn_weights[].tag, implicit_tags[], adds_tags[]). Tag nodes are extracted SOLELY from mods.json; inherits_from is null unless a candidate inheritance source (tags.json / tag_details.json) is present and resolved. Absence of an inheritance source never prevents Tag extraction.

ItemClass.source: uniques.json item_class (22 values) + base_items/* item_class (both REQUIRED; full observed vocabulary from both). repoe/item_classes.json is an optional candidate source for metadata only.
ItemClass.record_identification: One node per distinct item_class string.
ItemClass.provenance: observed from uniques.json / base_items (origin=source); item_classes.json candidate.
ItemClass.extraction_rule: Deterministic: union of distinct item_class values.

Buff.reason: requires repo/e buffs.json targeted profiling (candidate supporting source); grants_effects[].granted_effect_id (701 distinct) is retained in Modifier payload in the meantime.

required_for_extraction: repoe/buffs.json (missing — must be profiled before extraction)

unique_item_resolver.kind: deterministic lookup function, NOT a node type; results stored in UniqueItem payload fields.

methods.name: visual_identity.id -> modifier key
methods.status_on_match: resolved (direct naming match passing the filter)

methods.name: normalized effect/display-text matching
methods.rule: normalize (strip non-alphanumeric) each PoB Uniques effect line; match 24-char window against normalized mods.json text / ModItemExclusive text
methods.note: The MATCHING PROCEDURE is deterministic. Deterministic matching is NOT semantic validation: a method-2 match is a candidate association only and must not be treated as a confirmed mechanical relation. validated=false at extraction; a method-2 association only reaches status 'resolved' after explicit validation/confirmation in a later phase.

methods.name: replica -> base-unique resolution
methods.rule: replica key '...x' resolves via the base unique's ('...' without x) modifier set where applicable
methods.status_on_match: resolved (base-modifier set shared by the replica)

methods.name: passive-grant resolution
methods.rule: granted-mechanic key (e.g. JewelExpansionNaturesPatience) matched against mods.json keys and passive ids; target_type = the source the matched key actually lives in (verified: JewelExpansion* keys are mods.json records)
methods.target_type: Modifier or Passive (from the matched source)

status_rules.genuinely_absent_confirmed_requires_evid: evidence-backed absence from the structured mods/passive representation (e.g. retired content); NOT merely a failed lookup
status_rules.methods_not_equated: methods 1-4 have unequal evidential strength; per-association method is recorded
status_rules.sweep_880_is_candidate_only: the 880 are association-level text matches, not semantically validated resolution; methods 3-4 were not systematically applied in the sweep
status_rules.method_2_candidates_not_auto_confirmed: a method-2 match is a candidate association; it does not by itself make the node 'resolved'. Node resolution_status = 'resolved' only with >=1 confirmed (validated) association, or a method-1/3/4 match as specified above; an unvalidated method-2-only resolution keeps the node at 'partial_or_indirect'

unique_item_resolver.general_rule: Extraction performs deterministic MATCHING only; it NEVER performs semantic validation. No resolver-produced association is automatically a confirmed mechanical relation. 'validated' is always false at extraction; confirmation is a later-phase action.

required_for: T3 keystone<->conversion bridge (strong_casting <-> additive_spell_damage_..._at_%_value has NO structural link; bridge is translation text)

lookup_and_evidence.materialization: role-4 lookups are materialized during 4C/4D as derived lookup tables or used query-time over raw_records.db (not nodes)

not_a_node_retention.ModItemExclusive records: raw snapshot (role 5) + evidence for resolver method 2 (role 3)
not_a_node_retention.PoB Uniques text blocks: raw snapshot (role 5) + evidence for resolver method 2 (role 3)
not_a_node_retention.gems stat_conversions: Gem node payload (role 2) + T1 alias lookup

missing_dependencies_identified.missing: stat_translations must be retained as lookup/evidence (it is, in raw_records.db); a derived stat-alias/equivalence map is a Phase 5 concern, not required for extraction
